ModMetaData.name: FluffiesPlushies (retired: now part of Big Fluffies)
ModMetaData.author: Rihlsul
ModMetaData.description:
This mod has retired. Its plushies now live inside the main mods, with better art, names, descriptions and cuddles:
- Big Fluffies: pink fluffy plushies - Albino Fluffies: white fluffy plushies
If Plushies (by Twokay) is also active, colonists cuddle fluffy plushies and sleep better next to them, just like regular plushies.
This mod no longer adds anything. You can safely unsubscribe from it; loading it does nothing.
